name: c409_02_base_manifest_404
covers: base manifest read 404, no crash: a page reads the commit key and, before it reads the manifest the key names, a peer's commits rotate that manifest out of the retained list and a collection pass deletes it; the page's manifest read finds the unit gone and the boot decides the recovery screen (row 6, tree missing) instead of building on the stale key

labels.A: begin ordinary commit; A: upload u; A: a: open reads the fence and the commit key (current is the seeded manifest) and then reads the manifest; that read is held
labels.B: begin ordinary commit #1..#3; B: comm: b: twenty-one commits, each after the retention admission interval, so that every previous current enters the retained list; the twenty-first pushes the seeded manifest out of the twenty entries the list keeps
labels.GC: begin pass; GC: list keys; GC: read: g: a collection pass after b's last commit: the seeded tree is named by nothing and is retired; the pass is the step that releases a's held read
labels.A: read manifest m/B1.1.g1 -> missing; r: a: the manifest read finds nothing; open classifies the boot as the recovery screen, row 6 with the tree missing, and does not read the commit key again
